## Training Courses

:::: timeline-item
[SISMID]{.timeline-when}

<div>

### Reconstructing Transmission with Genomic Data

Co-taught with Caroline Colijn. Covers methods for transmission reconstruction (who infected whom) that combine epidemiological and genomic data: outbreaker2, TransPhylo, BREATH and others. Taught at the Summer Institute in Statistics and Modeling Infectious Diseases (University of Washington then Emory University) since 2020. You can access materials from a recent iteration of the course [here](https://jessicastockdale.github.io/SISMID2024-transmission-genomics/).

</div>
